title: Slow-cooker Oats
description: Pop the bread in the toaster and return the pan to the hob over a low heat. Stir in the cream cheese until well combined and heated through.
steps: Put all the ingredients for the oats into the heatproof bowl, jug or dish and stir well.
Place the bowl in the slow-cooker bowl and fill the slow-cooker insert with enough water to come halfway up the bowl.
Put the lid on the slow cooker and cook overnight on low. It will be ready to eat after 4–5 hours but will happily sit for 7 or even 8 hours until everyone has woken up!
Serve with your own topping or one of our delicious topping recipes.
notes: Serve with the Blueberry and Apple Oats topping (169 kcal) or Peanut Butter and Banana Oats topping (267 kcal).
